brief.zh: 维修站不同区域的温度记录混在一起。先分类，再比较每组的温度。
brief.en: Readings from different areas of the station are mixed together. Sort them into groups, then compare their temperatures.

concept.zh: 按类别分组，每组分别计算样本数和汇总值。
concept.en: Group rows by category, then count and summarize each group on its own.

body.zh: 把区域作为分组键。同一区域的读数放在一组，即使它们在原表里隔得很远。
body.en: Use area as the group key. Put readings from the same area together, even when they appear far apart in the original table.

title.en: Read the result alongside the count

body.zh: 每组用自己的读数算平均值。两个区域可以有相同平均值、不同的样本数。记录样本数，分清 1 次测量和多次测量得到的结果。
body.en: Calculate each mean using its own readings. Two areas can have the same mean with different sample counts. Keep the count so you know whether a result came from one measurement or several.

caption.zh: 四条记录按到达顺序排着。找一找哪些读数来自同一个区域。
caption.en: Four observations are arranged in arrival order. Find the readings that belong to the same area.

caption.zh: 机库的三个读数靠在一起，车间的一个读数另成一组。
caption.en: The hangar's three readings move together. The workshop's single reading forms its own group.

caption.zh: 汇总表每区一行。两个平均值都是 21°C，样本数分别是 3 和 1。
caption.en: The summary has one row per area. Both means are 21°C, but their counts are 3 and 1.

prompt.zh: 车间又测得 23°C，只更新哪一组？
prompt.en: The workshop records another reading of 23°C. Which group do you update?

feedback.zh: 车间组变成 2 条，平均值是 22°C。机库用的仍是原来三条。
feedback.en: The workshop now has two readings with a mean of 22°C. The hangar still uses its original three readings.
